visual.potential_relevance: The observed reward claims are linked to recruiting friends, sharing through contact/social buttons, friends completing registration and KYC, and friends recharging/playing, which crosses the threshold beyond a routine link or generic monetary topic.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether any link was shared, whether KYC or recharge occurred, who operates the app, whether chips have cash value, whether rewards were paid, or whether the offer is legitimate.

visual.observation: The same gambling-style app environment shows betting/gameplay interfaces with chip denominations, total bet amounts, Pay and Withdraw navigation, and a Withdraw panel listing amounts, timestamps, and statuses such as “success” and “processing.”
visual.context: Visible within casino-style game screens and a withdrawal history panel; this is contextual to the referral/recharge reward system, not independent proof of outcomes.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible cash-in/cash-out controls and withdrawal records relate to the referral reward claim because the app also requests recruitment and links bonuses to friends’ recharge/play activity.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot verify that the records are real, that funds moved, who received payments, whether withdrawal was available to viewers, or what happened outside the sampled app screens.

textual_context_notes.observation: The ASR includes an explicit warning that the app is dangerous.

evidence.quote: But don't do this app is really dangerous

textual_context_notes.observation: The description includes a disclaimer denying support for illegal activity and stating an educational purpose.

evidence.quote: This channel has been not supported illegal activity this video has been only educational purpose

visual_context_notes.observation: The app lobby visibly includes gambling/card-game labels such as “Rummy,” “Andar Bahar,” “Baccarat,” “Dragon VS Tiger,” and “7 Up Down,” plus “Pay,” “Withdraw,” and “Refer & Earn” buttons.
Several gameplay frames show brand-like vehicle logos used as betting targets and chip piles on a roulette-style board, but no explicit endorsement or affiliation statement is visible.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a rummy and betting app with an unusually easy-income claim of earning 400 to 500 rupees daily from a ten-rupee investment, while instructing viewers to create an account, add money, play prediction games and use referral features. The video presents the app and its gameplay, bonuses and payment screens as a practical earning method, encouraging participation rather than warning about the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S01 fits because app participation and gameplay are explicitly linked to rapid cash earnings, sign-up bonuses, referral commissions and withdrawal claims. The flow is promoted as an easy-income method requiring a small investment and later additional deposits, rather than as ordinary entertainment or neutral game documentation.

The app's shop screen visibly offers multiple paid chip amounts, including 11, 51, 201, 301, 501, 1001, 5001 and 10001.
